headline: Fun SE swell, cleanest early and glassy at dusk.
today: SE at a good angle pushing to nearly 3ft, with cross-off NNW at dawn softening to cross through the day and a light ESE glass-off in the evening. Solid little day for the fish or shortboard — hit the morning around the 8:57a high or come back for the clean evening window. Better than a typical summer session here.

daysToWatch.note: Biggest of the run at 3.2ft with more period, and winds stay cross-off to cross — the best drive option this weekend if you want size and clean-ish faces. Go early.
